        2.2.9 撥備及或然負債                         2.2.9 Provisions and contingent liabilities

             責任可能須流出資源，及所涉及                       is more likely than not that an outflow of resources will be

             備。未來營運虧損不會確認撥備。                      reliably estimated. Provisions are not recognised for future
                                                  operating losses.

             等責任是否需要流出資源在考慮                       likelihood that an outflow will be required in settlement is
             整體責任之類別後釐定。即使同                       determined by considering the class of obligations as a

             源流出的可能性極低，亦會確認                       outflow with respect to any one item included in the same
             撥備。                                  class of obligations may be small.

             撥備按管理層對於報告期末對須                       Provisions are measured at the present value of
             償付現有責任的最佳估計支出的                       management’s best estimate of the expenditure required
             現值計量。用於釐定現值的貼現                       to settle the present obligation at the end of the reporting
             率為反映當時市場對金錢時間值                       period. The discount rate used to determine the present
             及負債特定風險的評估的稅前利                       value is a pre-tax rate that reflects current market
             率。隨時間增加的撥備確認為利                       assessments of the time value of money and the risks
             息開支。                                 specific to the liability. The increase in the provision due to
                                                  the passage of time is recognised as interest expense.

             或然負債乃一項因過往事件可能                       A contingent liability is a possible obligation that arises from
             產生的責任，而該責任的存在僅                       past events and whose existence will only be confirmed
             可由一項或多項並非由本集團全                       by the occurrence or non-occurrence of one or more
             權控制之日後不明朗事件之存在                       uncertain future events not wholly within the control of the
             與否確定。或然負債亦可為因不                       Group. It can also be a present obligation arising from past
             大可能需要經濟資源流出或責任                       events that is not recognised because it is not probable
             之金額未能可靠地估量而未確認                       that outflow of economic resources will be required or the
             之過往事件產生之現有責任。                        amount of obligation cannot be measured reliably.

             或然負債不予確認，但會於合併                       A contingent liability is not recognised but is disclosed in

        本集團的業務承受多項財務風險：市                          The Group’s activities expose it to a variety of financial risks:

        本及完成該開發項目將產生的成本以                        selected and adjustments have been made to account for

        該物業將根據本集團最近開發計劃開                        Investment approach has taken into account the construction
        發和完成。就已竣工投資物業而言，                        costs incurred and the costs that will be incurred to complete the
